people getting mad at me about this bc Knicks had an easy path. First, they're blowing teams out every game and also the Knicks are going to be an underdog in every game against Spurs and Thunder. IF Brunson has a great series as a heavy underdog, we'll see what people say.

If Brunson has a great series and beats the spurs or thunder, it pains me to say but it will be the most rings-per-title of anyone in NBA history. More than Dirk or Giannis or 2016 Bron. Will be worth like 25 KD warriors rings.
You’re 7’6 and you studied w the Shaolin monks my friend. If you want to elbow the TikTok dancing dude who is always happy and living his life in the back, do it yourself.

Jokic was put on ‘no defense’ fraud watch and then he won a title and now he’s fine. Same w Dirk. LeBron was on fraud watch twice. Only the true greats who could be top 25 guys all time get put on fraud watch it’s an honor.

Giannis was on fraud watch when he was missing every free throw and then his leg bent backwards and he somehow came back a week later and won a title. And then we had to watch him lose in the 1st round and say silly shit for years and go ‘well he won a title.’ Fair is fair.

Alright I’m declaring it if Wemby ordered the code red (he clearly did) and if he sucks in game 6 bc he’s getting pushed around again and the Thunder win in San Antonio, we are putting him on fraud watch. This is the way of the NBA and it’s good.

Convinced Adam Silver forced the Sixers to do the McCain trade to make the Thunder way more likable. Very hard to hate this dude.


Hater Report (@HaterReport)

Jared McCain on the hard fouls at the end of the game: 

“Yeah that was crazy I didn’t expect it…we were at the free throw line and I was like ‘why’d you do that man’… and he was like ‘I got another one for you too’” 😭💀

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/HaterReport/status/2059572824277156072#m

My real problem w McCain is that he’s Filipino and he can’t really sing. Like tap into your heritage man and stop doing this off key weird emotion singing you do. Put two feet on the ground and belt it out on these TikToks.
I’m very interested in what Wemby was whispering to Biyombo when he checked out lol.
I don’t like it but in the distance a car is approaching with a ‘Wemby fraud watch’ sign on its roof. It comes for everyone fair is fair
This type of spot is why they got Fox and he’s gonna have to create some offense
Disgusting way to end the quarter. Clear goaltend, missed challenge, Shai flop.
I’m gonna need a break after this series bc I swear my 4 of my 5 favorite players in the NBA right now are Harper, Castle, McCain and Vassell
